mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cps_initial_review_config WHERE config_key = 'GLOBAL' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_initial_review_config (config_key, auto_trigger_enabled, max_retry_attempts, retry_backoff_ms, timeout_seconds, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{autoTriggerEnabled}, #{maxRetryAttempts}, #{retryBackoffMs}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{updatedBy}, NOW())
